PagerDuty: PAGER 
Service: eval-gate.safety-check
Severity: P2 -> high noisy safety rejects on production canary
Triggered rule: `eval_gate.score >= 0.7 && safety_reject_rate >= 0.25`
Occurrences: 18 in last 5m
Links: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PDT-45231

Oncall-Bot: Incident created INC-2024-45231, paging oncall group: @oncall (primary: Alice M). Auto-escalation in 5m if unacked.

Alice M: acked. I'm looking. First pass: which rollout triggered this?

Cheng L: this came from the continuous rollout for rwd-3b-v2-quant (canary=10%). Eval gate flagged increase in safety rejections for the promptset `payment_phrases`.

Alice M: thanks. ETA 5–10m. Can someone pull the eval hits (examples) and the failing outputs? I want to check false positives vs true safety hits.

Eva (ML): pulling examples now. Quick numbers: baseline reject_rate (rwd-3b-v1) = 0.04, current canary = 0.31. Average gate score delta +0.45. Looks real. Sending samples.

Brian K: @Alice M @Eva (ML) tagging support — Sam, are customers impacted or seeing errors or degraded UX?

Sam (Support): seeing increased tickets: 12 customers reported truncated/flagged responses in last 30m. One enterprise account reported blocking of a scheduled bot workflow. Escalated to AE. No billing impact.

Alice M: ok, classify as customer-visible. We should stop the canary and fallback to previous variant. Will execute abort and force-routing to rwd-3b-v1.

Cheng L: commands to run (console):
```bash
# abort rollout
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.internal/api/v1/rollouts/abort" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_OPS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"deployment":"rwd-3b-v2-quant","reason":"safety_gate_trip"}'

# set model override for prod route
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.internal/api/v1/routes/override" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_OPS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","model":"rwd-3b-v1"}'
```

Alice M: running abort now.

Oncall-Bot: Rollout abort accepted (op-id: op-78f9). Canary traffic readjusting.

Alice M: applied route override to rwd-3b-v1, confirmed via health check: 200 OK on /v1/generate for sample request.

Eva (ML): collecting diffs and sample pairs. Quick observation: new quantized kernels changed tokenization edge behavior causing shorter completions that trigger safety heuristics on specific prompts. This is likely a model-code interaction, not just data drift.

Brian K: good catch. Is it safe to re-enable quantization profile with tweaks or do we need to revert build?

Eva (ML): need to rollback quant build on the model CI and re-run targeted evals. I'll open a PR to disable the new kernel selection path and run nightly eval set. Target: mitigation branch that preserves previous kernel for safety-sensitive prompt classes.

Alice M: immediate mitigation: abort done, override in place. Sam, please update the support tickets: note that canary was rolled back and we have a mitigation plan. Ask affected customers if they can re-test in 30m.

Sam (Support): on it. I'll push an update to the shared incident doc and message the affected customers.

Cheng L: creating postmortem stub: https://docs.internal/incidents/INC-2024-45231. Please add execution timeline and sample outputs.

Alice M: also let's add a short-term alert to reduce noise: lower sensitivity for the gate for 1 hour while we triage so we don't page again for transient flaps. Can someone patch eval-gate rule?

Eva (ML): patching rule: increase min_samples=30 and vote_threshold to 0.75 for the rolling window. Applying now.

Oncall-Bot: Alert rule updated by Eva (ML). New params: min_samples=30, vote_threshold=0.75.

PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by Alice M. Escalation canceled.

Alice M: summary and next steps:
- Actioned: aborted rollout, routed prod to rwd-3b-v1 override
- Customer impact: ~12 tickets, several workflows blocked, no data loss
- Next: ML to revert kernel selector in quantized build, run targeted evals; infra to add safer rollout guard; support to notify customers

Cheng L: assigning owners: Eva (ML) -> kernel rollback & evals; Brian K -> infra rollout guard; Sam -> customer comms; Alice M -> incident lead & postmortem

Alice M: closing page for now. If the gate pages again after rollback we re-open. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Sam (Support): updated tickets and incident doc, pinged AE.

Eva (ML): PR opened: https://git.internal/rwd/runtime/pulls/1423 (WIP). Will run targeted evals and report back in ~2h.

Alice M: last check: traffic metrics show fallback healthy. closing thread.

-- end of thread --
